title: The last handoff checkpoint comes before the cloud compacts
why: Decision precompact-handoff rule 2 puts the last handoff checkpoint near 450k, but cloud sessions compact at 384k (found by the idle-resume-compacts lane, Nov 1 19:24 CST). A cloud lane may compact before its last handoff and lose rulings.
note: Done by PR #982's work (branch head 5fdd0a98 is on main da8d8073); no code change. Measured Nov 3 17:02 CST by lane [ended:lane:-handoff-checkpoint-before-cloud-compact]: in coordinator [ended:Claude-settings-coordinator-handoff] (override 92, platform threshold 441,600) the handoff nudge fired 16:33 CST at 359k context, handoff written 16:34 CST; auto compaction at 16:53 CST, pre_tokens 442,500: the checkpoint came 83k tokens and 19 min before compaction (list_events, compact_boundary event 162fb488). In the lane (override 80) the hook's compact_threshold 384,000 equals the platform threshold 384,000. The hook reads CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE live and takes the lower of the precompute point (408k) and the override point; the 450k checkpoint in why is gone. Earlier note: Unmeasured. First measure: in a cloud session, read the size at which compaction fires and whether the 450k checkpoint ran before it. If it did not, set the checkpoint below the platform trigger for each surface (cloud 384k; desktop by its window). Red first: a fixture at 390k in the cloud gets its checkpoint before compaction. Related: handoff-checkpoint-before-compact. Port: yes, the hook is shared. Ready. Nov 1 19:36 CST: PR #982 (part 1) now aligns checkpoints to Claude Code's trigger; this step keeps only the cloud measurement, and closes if #982 covers the cloud trigger. Lane [ended:lane:-handoff-checkpoint-before-cloud-compact], started by the coordinator Nov 3 16:57 CST.
